_comment: All external download sources for real-JEV. run.py reads this on first launch and installs everything automatically. Nothing large is committed to the repo; it is fetched on setup and cached under ~/.cache/real-jev (Linux) so it never bloats the project.

ollama.note: The linux-*.tar.zst archives bundle the ollama binary AND its native libraries (lib/ollama). run.py extracts them locally, no sudo required.

default_model_note: run.py picks the largest model whose min_ram_gb is <= your detected RAM. Models are pulled by tag from the Ollama registry (ollama pull <tag>); the full catalog lives in app/catalog.py and the Models tab.
